name: Basri Ket
description: Basri Ket is a sandbending planeswalker from Amonkhet who was utterly devoted to the god Oketra.

description_citations.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Basri Ket is a sandbending planeswalker from Amonkhet who was utterly devoted to the god Oketra.

citations.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Basri was utterly devoted to Oketra for most of his life, until she was slain in the Hour of Devastation, shattering his world.

citations.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: He took up one of Oketra's massive arrows as a spear and vowed to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.

citations.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Basri brings two teenage twin embalmers to his former crop-mate Mahitab and offers to pay for the location of Temmet's tomb, then vows to protect the twins with his life.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

bio.text: On the desert trek he topples a sandwurm with sand, carries the injured Merinaten, and uses sandbending to uncover the tomb's entrance.

bio.text: When Niharet holds a khopesh at his throat, Basri prays and the top of the pyramid is torn off by a giant, and Mahitab bitterly leaves with him toward his new god.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

bio.text: Racing with the Champions, he fights insects with sand blades alongside his old friend Zahur, and later shields civilians with sand that turns to glass in a dragon's heat.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

bio.text: He and Zahur cross the finish line first, and the Champions receive the Aetherspark together as a team.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story, Basri is alive, and he and the Champions have received the Aetherspark together after crossing the finish line first.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Answering Basri's prayers, Ketramose tears off the tomb roof, tosses Munhatep aside and revives Temmet.
timeline.quote: The god revived Temmet, declaring that he would serve Ketramose as he had Oketra.

citation.text: "Ketramose", section "2 nd Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri Ket offers Mahitab and Niharet money for the location of Temmet's tomb, hoping to revive him.
timeline.quote: Basri hoped to awaken the former vizier as part of a larger plan to revive Oketra and heal Naktamun.

citation.text: "Temmet", section "2 nd Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Munhatep interrupts the party at the pyramid, demands Temmet's body, and takes it.
timeline.quote: Munhatep removed Temmet's body and prepared to retreat

citation.text: "Temmet", section "2 nd Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri completes Oketra's Trial of Solidarity, shielding his crop with sand; his spark ignites and he is carried to another plane.
timeline.quote: Basri's latent Planeswalker's spark ignited and he found himself on another plane

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri returns to Amonkhet to find it a smoking ruin and Oketra dead.
timeline.quote: Oketra was dead, and everything he had believed turned out to be an elaborate lie.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a crisis of faith, Basri rallies the injured and realizes Oketra's teachings still live on.
timeline.quote: He rounded up the injured and weary, encouraged them with what he knew

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri loses his planeswalking abilities in the Desparkening.
timeline.quote: he lost his planeswalking abilities in the Desparkening .

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri sets out with Mahitab, Niharet and two embalmers across the desert to find Temmet's tomb to revive him.
timeline.quote: They set off across the desert, surviving an attack from a sandwurm , and reached the tomb.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "Rebuilding Naktamun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the tomb Munhatep confronts them and Niharet betrays them; the new god Ketramose, summoned by Basri's faith, destroys the Chitin Court warriors and bears Temmet's body to Naktamun.
timeline.quote: He destroyed the Chitin Court warriors and bore Temmet's body back to Naktamun.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "Rebuilding Naktamun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri discovers Zahur's tomb on an expedition and performs the rites to awaken him.
timeline.quote: Basri discovered Zahur 's tomb and performed the rites to awaken him.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "Rebuilding Naktamun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Basri brings two teenage twin embalmers to Mahitab for a trek to find Temmet, and she objects.
timeline.quote: You've brought me children.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri tells Mahitab and Niharet he will pay for the location of Temmet's tomb, which only they know.
timeline.quote: Mahitab and Niharet were the only remaining members of the crew that had entombed Temmet, the only ones who knew where he could be found.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri kneels and vows to protect the twins with his life.
timeline.quote: You have my word. My life for theirs, if that's what it takes.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The five set out into the desert at dusk.
timeline.quote: The five of them set out at dusk.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: At camp, Niharet suggests other gods protect them, and Basri argues about the Chitin Court.
timeline.quote: Perhaps we're protected by other gods.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A sandwurm erupts from the sand and swallows Merinaten.
timeline.quote: When the sandwurm erupted from beneath the sands and swallowed Merinaten

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri topples the wurm with sand and Mahitab kills it.
timeline.quote: she raised up her blade and sank it to the hilt in the creature's head

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The party pulls Merinaten from the wurm's mouth and binds her wounds.
timeline.quote: Merinaten screamed, and she was free.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri carries the injured Merinaten on his back so they can finish the journey.
timeline.quote: I'll carry Meri.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mahitab finds the half-buried pyramid by the stars.
timeline.quote: a pyramid, half-buried in the sand, but still the height of five people stacked atop one another

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri uses sandbending to uncover the tomb's buried entrance.
timeline.quote: He raised his spear and very slowly the sand began to rise.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The party finds Temmet's simple sarcophagus in a square chamber.
timeline.quote: That's Temmet.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Seven figures, almost all undead, confront the party in the tomb.
timeline.quote: Before her stood a group of seven people, and all but one of them undead.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Niharet holds her khopesh at Basri's throat, betraying the party.
timeline.quote: Niharet was at Basri's back, her khopesh held at his neck.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri prays and the top of the pyramid is torn off by a giant.
timeline.quote: Then the top of the pyramid tore right off.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mahitab bitterly leaves with Basri toward his new god.
timeline.quote: Let's go, Basri. Your new god awaits.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: An older Champion dies throwing himself in front of a blow meant for Zahur.
timeline.quote: Basri watches an older member of the Champions throw himself before a wicked slice meant for Zahur.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri lifts the fallen charioteer to the lazotep servants on a cloud of sand.
timeline.quote: On a conjured cloud of sand, he lifts the fallen charioteer.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri leaps between chariots turning sand into blades to fend off insects.
timeline.quote: he leaps from one to the other, like stones across a pond, while turning the sand around him into slicing blades

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The demon's claw knocks a wheel off the Champions' lead chariot and sends them toward a statue.
timeline.quote: The claw that would have torn Chandra apart instead knocks a wheel free from the lead chariot.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire sees the raised Khuru riding with Basri and Zahur.
timeline.quote: the man who died saving Zahur only yesterday

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri shields civilians with sand that turns to glass in the dragon's heat.
timeline.quote: Basri Ket conjured waves of sand to shield the fleeing civilians

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Zahur and Basri realize they have crossed the finish line first, and Zahur declares the Aetherspark's blessing.
timeline.quote: For life, for death, for Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The Champions receive the Aetherspark together as a team.
timeline.quote: When they receive the Aetherspark, it is as a team—no one person's hand touches it before any other.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri leads the Amonkheti delegation in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix with Zahur; Zahur crosses the finish line first, winning the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: Zahur would be the first to cross the finish line, winning the Aetherspark for the team.

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oketra is slain in the Hour of Devastation, shattering Basri's world.
timeline.quote: When she was slain in the Hour of Devastation, his world was shattered.

citation.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Basri takes up one of Oketra's massive arrows as a spear and vows to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: he took up one of her massive arrows as a spear and vowed to champion her ideals across the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Betrayed the group, aligned with the old gods.
relations.quote: betrayed by Niharet, who was also aligned with the old gods

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "Rebuilding Naktamun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Summoned by his faith, he saves the group.
relations.quote: a new god summoned by Basri's faith in Oketra

citation.text: "Basri Ket", section "Rebuilding Naktamun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A white-and-gold armored sandbending hero and devotee of Oketra who hires Mahitab to find Temmet.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: Amonkhet's sand-bending living champion racing with the Champions of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: The sand-bending Amonkheti champion who cuts through falling trees.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: The sand-bending champion who shields civilians and crosses the finish line first.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: A Human former planeswalker and sand-mage from Amonkhet, a paladin devoted to Oketra who became the plane's champion folk hero.

citation.text: "Basri Ket". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A planeswalker once utterly devoted to the god Oketra, who now champions her ideals across the Multiverse with one of her arrows as a spear.

citation.text: "Basri Ket". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Confronts Munhatep at Temmet's tomb and prays to Ketramose.

citation.text: "Ketramose". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Temmet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
